scripts.dev:concurrent: npm run build -w shared && concurrently -k -n API,WEB -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev:watch -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w shared && npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client && npm run typecheck:netlify && npm run typecheck:vercel
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w server && npm run lint -w client
scripts.test: npm run test -w server && npm run test -w client && npm run test:vercel
